_schema_doc: Text trigger rules for auto-dismissing popups and completing simple dialogs the bot gets stuck on. Each rule: match phrase (case-insensitive substring) + response action. Order matters — first match wins. Add rules as new stuck-states are discovered.

_actions_supported.click_at_match: Click the center of where the matched text was found
_actions_supported.click_at: Click at fixed pixel coords relative to Roblox window (params: {x, y})
